speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether the Ministry will consider providing grants for fees for faith-based preschools run by non-profit organisations, such as those by churches, mosques and voluntary welfare organisations.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We seek to achieve this by providing support to both parents and operators.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Apart from subsidies, the Government provides broad-based funding support which is available to all operators to help them raise the quality of their preschools.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: This includes the Professional Development Programmes which all preschools can tap on to upskill their educators, as well as grants to improve productivity through technology solutions and to foster more innovative teaching practices.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: In addition, we support eligible operators under the Anchor Operator (AOP) and Partner Operator (POP) schemes with recurrent funding to uplift preschool quality while providing affordable options.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: All preschools can also tap on the Preschool Opportunity Fund, which provides funding support for preschool programmes that provide holistic development opportunities for lower-income children.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The Government will continue to review policies to improve access to quality and affordable preschools across the sector, so that every child can have a good start in life.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I am assured that there are sufficient subsidies and grants available for both students and staff in the preschool sector.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I do recognise that AOPs, POPs and Ministry of Education (MOE) Kindergartens (MKs) are there to help and expand the preschool sector and ensure that there is quality education.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: However, kindergartens run by faith-based organisations do serve a specific segment of our society, particularly parents who are looking for certain value-based systems that they want to enrol their children in.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: So, I hope that the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) would also consider expanding the Kindergarten Fee Assistance Scheme (KiFAS) to all children, regardless of which preschool centre or kindergarten that they enrol in, very much like how the Edusave accounts are made available to primary school and secondary school students, regardless of which school they enrol in.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Can I also clarify that the Opportunity Fund is available even to students who are enrolled in kindergartens run by faith-based organisations?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Indeed, the preschool sector remains diverse, comprising commercial, not-for-profit, faith-affiliated and MOE-run preschools, each with their own value propositions.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: And with these, parents continue to have choice in selecting a suitable preschool for their children.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, this, as the Member mentioned earlier, is part of our strategy to provide parents with quality and affordable kindergarten places.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: It essentially is to support their enrolled children from less advantaged or at-risk backgrounds.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Nevertheless, we feel that kindergartens continue to play a very important role in offering preschool programmes to parents who do not need full-day care for their children.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We will take that into consideration and we will provide an update on the review when it is completed.
